intro: Lumi coffee table pairs the cool elegance of natural marble with the warmth of sculpted mango wood. Its rounded form and generous surface create a refined focal point for modern living spaces.

features.title: Spacious tabletop for effortless hosting
features.text: The smooth, white natural marble surface of Lumi offers ample room for books, beverages, and decorative accents. Its generous proportions support both everyday use and relaxed gatherings.

features.title: Rounded design with natural marble surface
features.text: The circular marble top introduces softness and balance into the room. The table’s polished finish adds a refined, luminous quality that enhances contemporary interiors.

features.title: Robust mango wood base for stable support
features.text: Crafted from mango wood, the understructure provides dependable strength and durability. The table’s solid construction ensures long-term stability without compromising design elegance.

features.title: Sculptural curved base with architectural depth
features.text: The mango wood base features gently curved panels that echo the round tabletop. This sculptural detailing adds dimension while reinforcing structural integrity.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
